findings.description: The plan pins 008 names that the delivered 008 does not expose as such: there is no LiveSettingsEffects (delivered: LiveEffectsPort/TauriEffects and tauri_adapter write/set/edit/set_prepared/ordered/commit_prepared_edit/repair). findings.description: Delivered 008 resolves the aliases edit->update and delete->remove before checking a domain's actions. A prompts domain that declares 'delete' as its action would refuse 'prompts delete' with usage_error.
